search_text: published ZDI-17-412 ZDI-CAN-4709 Apple Safari Element Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2017-06-21 CVE-2017-2530 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2017-2530 6.8 ['Apple'] ['Safari'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple Safari. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the handling of Element objects. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the current process. Apple has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. title: Apple Safari Element Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Apple Safari. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file. The specific flaw exists within the handling of Element objects. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code under the context of the current process.
